Sidebar sub menu

Motion·by @ThatsPranav·2026-08-25·inspora page·original post

What it is

Docs sidebar sub-menu: a docs nav where expanding a section (Transactional Email, Email Analytics, AI Email Templates) draws an animated elbow connector down to its children; the active section gets a colored left accent bar that slides to follow selection, child rows stagger in, and hover sweeps a grey fill.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Transactional Email expanded (orange accent): children Send API / React Email supported / Webhooks connected by a thin elbow line from the parent; hover darkens the hovered row's text.
20-40%
Selection moves to Email Analytics: orange accent bar slides up and collapses, blue accent bar slides down beside Email Analytics while its elbow connector draws downward stroke-by-stroke; children (Metrics, Engagement & clicks, Bounces & Diagnostics) fade+slide in with 40ms stagger.
40-70%
Hover sweeps through Email Analytics children; cursor row gets medium-weight text.
70-100%
AI Email Templates expands (purple accent), previous section collapses (elbow retracts, children fade up and out); its children stagger in; hover continues through them.

Build prompt

Build a docs sidebar with an animated tree connector. Sidebar 220px: section rows (14px, medium when active) each with a leading 3px accent bar slot. One shared accent indicator: absolutely positioned 3x20px bar that slides vertically to the clicked section (300ms ease-in-out) and crossfades to that section's color (orange/blue/purple). Expanding a section draws its connector: an SVG path from the parent's icon elbow-curving down (12px radius corner) then straight to the last child - animate stroke-dashoffset over 250ms ease-out, then reveal children (Send API / React Email supported / Webhooks style rows with mini icons) at 40ms stagger, each fading + rising 4px. Collapsing retracts the dash (children fade up and vanish first, 200ms). Only one section open at a time (accordion). Hover: row text goes grey-500 -> grey-900 with a 120ms color ease.

Mechanics

trigger
section click (accordion) + row hover
elements
3 section rows, accent bar (shared, slides), animated elbow connector (SVG path), child rows
properties
accent bar y + color, connector stroke-dashoffset draw, child row opacity + translateY, row text weight on hover
timing
connector draw 250ms; children stagger 40ms; accent slide 300ms; collapse 200ms
easing
ease-out draws; ease-in-out accent slide
loop
no
